The '''E3 Companion Droid''' was a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. [[Spanner (Exovar's droid)|Spanner]], [[Luskin Exovar]]'s droid, was an E3 Companion Droid.<ref name="WHSV" />
